mapper.select: select account_code, user_code, enterprise_code, email, pass, factory, smtp_host, smtp_port, smtp_auth, smtp_ssl, pop3_host, pop3_port, pop3_auth, pop3_ssl from email_base.t_external_mail_account where enterprise_code = #{enterpriseCode} and user_code = #{userCode} limit 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO email_base.t_external_mail_account(account_code, user_code, enterprise_code, email, pass, factory, smtp_host, smtp_port, smtp_auth, smtp_ssl, pop3_host, pop3_port, pop3_auth, pop3_ssl) VALUES (#{entity.accountCode}, #{entity.userCode}, #{entity.enterpriseCode}, #{entity.email}, #{entity.pass}, #{entity.factory}, #{entity.smtpHost}, #{entity.smtpPort}, #{entity.smtpAuth}, #{entity.smtpSsl}, #{entity.pop3Host}, #{entity.pop3Port}, #{entity.pop3Auth}, #{entity.pop3Ssl})
mapper.update: UPDATE email_base.t_external_mail_account set email = #{account.email}, pass = #{account.pass}, factory = #{account.factory}, smtp_host = #{account.smtpHost}, smtp_port = #{account.smtpPort}, smtp_auth = #{account.smtpAuth}, smtp_ssl = #{account.smtpSsl}, pop3_host = #{account.pop3Host}, pop3_port = #{account.pop3Port}, pop3_auth = #{account.pop3Auth}, pop3_ssl = #{account.pop3Ssl} where account_code = #{account.accountCode} and enterprise_code = #{account.enterpriseCode} and user_code = #{account.userCode}
